start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:give-paid-buyers-access for offer offer:sourdough-club, customer records of type record:club-customer, email provider resend from club@example.com, with a setup email saying how to pick up the first loaf."
no_lists_because: It names no list: it keeps customer records of the type you give it as customer_record_type, one per paid checkout, through your records.
instructions: 1. Declare the offer with its prices and connect Stripe; name the email provider you connected and the from address.

2. Say "Run workflow:give-paid-buyers-access" with offer_id, email_provider, from and setup_email (subject and text, with {email} and {people} placeholders); customer_record_type and start_unix are optional.
3. Schedule it every 15 minutes. Each run lists checkouts paid since the last one kept, checks each amount against a declared price and keeps one record per checkout.
4. Read what it tells you: a checkout whose amount matches no price is not kept and is named to you.
5. Each new customer gets the setup email once; customers whose subscription ended are marked ended and keep their record.
